tei:div.tei:p: 219) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs myur thob shin tu gsang ba'i rgya can bzhugs: na mo: rang byung rig pa don gyi lhar: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: sems dang sems byung rgyud lnga'i 'gro: ye grol chen por sems bskyed do: āḥ mtha' brgyad bral ba ka dag che: 'gag med rang gsal kun tu gzigs: lhun grub ye shes dkyil 'khor dbus: bam̐ las rang nyid mtsho rgyal dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: snang ba dbang sdud lcags kyu dang: g.yon pas bhan thod thugs kar 'dzin: dpa' bo'i tshogs kyi dgyes pa bskang: zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad zlar bzhugs: nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug dang: utpal dmar po'i chun pas brgyan: dar dpyangs rin chen mdzes pas spras: sku la rgyud sde'i lha rnams rdzogs: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: thugs kar bam̐ dmar mtha' bskor du: sngags g.yon 'khor las 'od zer 'phros: don gnyis 'grub cing 'khor 'das kun: ma lus dbang 220)du 'du bar bsam: dag pa rab 'byams ngang du bzla: oṃ padma dzñā na ḍā ki ni sa rā dza ya sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐:

zhes pa mi tshig ma 'dres par: 'bum tsho gcig gis 'grub par nges: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: dam nyams kun gyi dbang po snubs: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do: ḍā ki'i rgya: : zhes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs myur 'thob 'di yang mchog sprul rin chen 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros kyi dngos slob padma 'od gsal gyis dar bcas bskul ngor/ sprang mo mdo med 'chol ma dud 'gro lta bu'i 'du shes gsum pa mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rdo rjes brdzun snang gi ri mo bris pa dge'o// chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ḍā ki'i tshogs mchod rgyun khyer snying po bzhugs: oṃ: skye med spros bral bhandha'i nang: ā: 'gag med rig rtsal sna tshogs rdzas: hūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: ha ho hrīḥ 'khor 'das dag mnyam chen po la: snang rtsal 'gag med mchod pa'i rdzas: tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan du shar: kun bzang mchod sprin bla na med: mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i tshogs 221)su 'bul: 'dzin zhen bral bas thugs dam bskang: gnyis snang bag chags dbyings su bshags: log rtog dbyings bsgral zhal du bstabs: thabs shes rdzas mchog dngos grub rol: a la la ho: snang srid mgron gyur lhag mas tshims: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: de ltar 'bad pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas: 'bras bu ye shes tshogs chen rab rdzogs te: sku gnyis zung 'jug mchog gi sa 'thob 'gyur: zab bo phyi rabs skal ldan nyams su longs: skal med log lta can la gu hya rgya: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer zungs sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : zhes pa ḍā ki'i tshogs mchod zab mo 'di yang padma 'od gsal rdo rjes rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇḍal bcas bskul ngor sprang mdo med 'chol mo su kha badzra gyis chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong nas brdzun ris su bris pa dge'o//
